Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the CollectorConfInfoServlet servlet. The issue lies in the failure to sanitize the filenames uploaded to the servlet. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of SYSTEM.
